run_whisper_offline_inference: run offline inference with Whisper model using vLLM for audio transcription with implicit or explicit encoder/decoder prompts
run_fireredasr2_asr: run offline speech-to-text transcription with FireRedASR2 model using vLLM and audio prompts
run_fireredlid_language_id: run offline language identification on audio clips with FireRedLID model using vLLM
run_encoder_decoder_multimodal: run offline multimodal inference on encoder-decoder LMMs with audio via argparse CLI selecting whisper, fireredasr2, or fireredlid
create_model_request_data: create a ModelRequestData NamedTuple pairing EngineArgs with a sequence of multimodal prompts for vLLM inference
